audience.title: Who can read it
audience.description: Everyone, or only readers who log in with DigiD or eHerkenning through a trusted portal. The public website, search, the sitemaps and the feeds leave a publication for signed-in readers out.

x-enum-labels.signedIn: Readers who log in with DigiD or eHerkenning

minimumAssurance.title: Minimum login level
minimumAssurance.description: The lowest login level a portal must vouch for before its reader is shown a publication for signed-in readers.

actForSignedInReaders.title: May act for signed-in readers
actForSignedInReaders.description: Whether a portal holding this consumer's key may read a publication for signed-in readers on behalf of a reader whose login level it sends.
